links.job_id_evidence: Per-run values asserted in-test but excluded from this deterministic artifact: queue job_id (uuid4), bus transaction_id (tx_{uuid4}), project state_hash (digests that tx uuid). Stable provenance kept here: command_id → operation_id → revision 1..5 → artifact sha256/size/duration.
links.bus_state_limitation: Project/EditTransaction state is in-memory per CommandBus by contract (PR#68): durable reopen covers job rows + artifact facts; bus history reopen across restart is NOT_VERIFIED (no persistence layer exists).
